bibl.title: Two dated Coptic epitaphs from Dongola.
bibl.seg: Jacques van der Vliet, Two dated Coptic epitaphs from Dongola.
bibl.note: The two epitaphs were discovered during the 2015 and 2018 campaigns of the Polish Centre for Mediterranean Archeology of the University of Warsaw at the site of the monastery on Kom H at Dongola. - 1. Inv. Hdd.18.322. Epitaph [in Coptic] of a monk Michaelinkouda; verso: apotropaic inscriptions [in Greek]. 4 April 758. - 2. Inv. Hdd.2015.001 (a) and (b). Epitaph [in Coptic] of a cleric. AD 771/2.
